'''Erna Martha Frins Pereira''' (born 31 December 1960) is a [[Uruguay]]an physicist. She works as a professor and researcher at the [[University of the Republic (Uruguay)|University of the Republic]]. She was president of the Uruguayan Physics Society from 2007 to 2011. In 2012 she won the [[L'Oréal-UNESCO Awards for Women in Science|National L'Oréal-UNESCO Award for Women in Science]] for her research in [[environmental physics]].

==Career==
Between 1979 and 1986, Frins studied chemistry and physics at the University of the Republic. In 1992 she obtained a master's degree in physics from [[Technische Universität Berlin]], Germany, with a thesis on the properties of solid state tuneable lasers. In 1992 she joined the Institute of Physics of the University of the Republic's {{ill|Faculty of Engineering (University of the Republic)|es|Facultad de Ingeniería (Universidad de la República)|lt=Faculty of Engineering}}. In 1998 she completed her PhD in sciences with a specialization in physics at [[Goethe University Frankfurt]], from the study of applications in optics of topological phases.<ref name=gana>{{Cite web |url=http://www.universidad.edu.uy/prensa/renderItem/itemId/31914/refererPageId/12 |title=Erna Frins gana Premio Nacional L'Oréal-UNESCO 'Por las mujeres en la ciencia' |trans-title=Erna Frins Wins National L'Oréal-UNESCO Award 'for Women in Science' |publisher=[[University of the Republic (Uruguay)|University of the Republic]] |language=Spanish |date=25 October 2012 |access-date=19 November 2017 |archive-date=1 December 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171201032046/http://www.universidad.edu.uy/prensa/renderItem/itemId/31914/refererPageId/12 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name=SNICV>{{Cite web |url=https://buscadores.anii.org.uy/buscador_sni/exportador/ExportarPdf?hash=48f2577d49f625e808dc9bcf8fce7372 |title=Curriculum Vitae |publisher=National System of Researchers of Uruguay |language=Spanish |date=20 July 2017 |access-date=19 November 2017 }}{{Dead link|date=December 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

Beginning in 1999 she coordinated a research team focused on the development of optical methods for remote monitoring of the atmosphere at the Institute of Physics, Applied Optics Group of the University of the Republic. She is a Grade 4 Associate Professor at the Faculty of Engineering of the University of the Republic and Grade 4 researcher of the {{ill|Programa de Desarrollo de las Ciencias Básicas|es}} (PEDECIBA).<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.pedeciba.edu.uy/fisica/investigadores-fisica.php |title=Area Física – Investigadores |trans-title=Physics Area – Researchers |publisher=PEDECIBA |language=Spanish |access-date=19 November 2017 |archive-date=11 July 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190711041215/http://www.pedeciba.edu.uy/fisica/investigadores-fisica.php |url-status=dead }}</ref> Since 2004 she has been an active member of the National System of Researchers of Uruguay.<ref name=gana/>

Frins was president of the Uruguayan Physics Society for two consecutive periods between 2007 and 2011.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://s-u-f.blogspot.com.uy/p/directiva.html |title=Directiva |publisher=Uruguayan Physics Society |language=Spanish |access-date=19 November 2017}}</ref>

In 2012 she won the National L'Oréal-UNESCO Award for Women in Science, for her project "Métodos ópticos para el estudio de emisiones gaseosas generadas en la operación de centrales térmicas". The project focuses on the development of an optical method for the study of gas emissions in thermal power plants. The technology allows the location of gases that pollute the atmosphere, placing them at specific coordinates.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.pedeciba.edu.uy/QueEs/monitoreo.html |title=¿Qué es el monitoreo atmosférico? |trans-title=What is Atmospheric Monitoring? |publisher=PEDECIBA |language=Spanish |access-date=19 November 2017 |archive-date=25 October 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201025073342/http://pedeciba.edu.uy/QueEs/monitoreo.html |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.cromo.com.uy/sacarle-una-foto-la-contaminacion-n524223 |title=Sacarle una foto a la contaminación |trans-title=Take a Photo of Pollution |last=González |first=Noelia |work=Cromo |language=Spanish |date=31 October 2012 |access-date=19 November 2017}}</ref>

Frins has carried out numerous research projects in different scientific areas, and has more than 60 publications in scientific media.<ref name=SNICV/><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Erna_Frins |title=Erna Frins |access-date=19 November 2017}}</ref>
